title: Soft-ventilation egress siphon and deferred-circuit patch
author: Aisha Patel
description: Context: A small but observed class of incidents showed short multi-region thundering spikes where the fastpath stayed healthy but egress saturation (downstream model IO) created tail latency cascades and then aggressive circuit flips. Motivation: provide a soft 'ventilation' path that gently siphons a configurable fraction of low-priority requests to a controlled slowpath/egress-trim pipeline while deferring hard circuit flips until telemetry confirms persistent degradation. This reduces noisy circuit churn and prevents mass failovers during transient egress pressure. What this PR does: 1) Introduces an EgressSiphon controller that can be attached to existing admission and routing layers to probabilistically divert or slow low-priority requests based on recent egress queue depth and token-level telemetry. 2) Adds a DeferredCircuit state machine that delays full circuit tripping for a short hysteresis window and requires both metrics and sampled trace evidence before moving to OPEN. 3) Adds telemetry guards: lightweight sampling rules that emit a preflight event for siphoned requests so we can correlate siphon volume with downstream error budget usage. 4) Runtime knobs: per-tenant weight, min-siphon-fraction, max-siphon-fraction, egress-queue-threshold, defer-window-ms. 5) Minimal operator docs and a small k8s CRD and rollout recipe for safe enablement. Rollout plan: feature-flagged off by default; staged rollout in canary region -> regional ramp -> global. Hotfix rationale: accelerated to a hotfix because it prevents an immediate class of circuit storms that were contributing to 3rd-party throttles. Testing: unit tests for state transitions, integration test that simulates egress pressure and validates reduced circuit flips, and a short e2e in staging with synthetic load. Ops: added telemetry tags (siphon.variant, siphon.reason) and a dashboard snapshot for the first 72 hours. Related: hooks into ENG-4198 for long-term admission shaping and SRE-702 for incident runbook updates. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests - [x] Integration test - [x] Load test in staging - [x] Docs + CRD - [x] Telemetry dashboards and alerts - [x] Rollout plan and rollback steps Notes: This is intentionally conservative: siphon fraction starts at 1% and will auto-scale up to configured max only when egress queue > threshold for > defer-window. The deferred circuit requires both metric and sampled trace error correlation to prevent flipping on noisy single-metric spikes.

test(egress): simulation harness for egress backpressure scenarios
docs: add operational guide and k8s CRD for egress siphon
diff_summary: Implemented EgressSiphon (~320 lines), DeferredCircuit (~140 lines), small telemetry tagging and CRD YAML. Tests added ~200 lines across unit and integration harness. Docs and CI script additions.
review_comments: Marco Liu: Can we avoid adding an extra goroutine per tenant in the hot path? Suggest using shared sampler with tenant tags — responded: switched to shared sampled emitter, updated implementation to the pooled emitter

Nina Gomez: How will this interact with existing KV cache warmups? Concern that siphoned slowpath might miss cached KV leading to work amplification — responded: siphon respects cache presence; fastpath cache hits bypass siphon (added test).
Daniel Reiss: CI flaky on integration run (timeout) — addressed by increasing harness timeouts and splitting the heavy scenario into a separate job.
ci_notes: Initial CI run failed on integration timeout; retried integration job with extended timeout. Lint and unit tests passed on first run. Full pipeline passed on rerun.
testing_summary: Unit: state transitions, sampling rules. Integration: simulated egress saturation with synthetic model latency — verified 60-70% reduction in circuit flips and stable request success for high-priority traffic. Staging e2e: no regressions in latency p95 for fastpath; observed siphon traffic at configured 1-5% window.
rollout_instructions: Gate: feature flag 'egress_siphon_v1' default=false. Phase 1: enable in canary region at 1% siphon fraction for 2 hours, monitor 'siphon.error_rate' and 'circuit.flip_rate'. Phase 2: ramp to 5% in canary, 0.5% in 2 additional regions. Phase 3: conditional global ramp to configured defaults if circuit_flip_rate falls >30% vs baseline. Rollback: flip feature flag off and wait one defer-window for circuits to settle. Operators: follow SRE-702 runbook for incident triage.
release_notes: Added a conservative egress siphon (soft vent) and deferred circuit logic to reduce noisy circuit storms under transient egress pressure. Feature-flagged and off by default. Operators can enable per-tenant with CRD. Improves stability during short-lived downstream saturation.
backport_plan: Backport to release/2026-02 branch if urgent; a minimal backport patch is prepared in branch release/2026-02/egress-siphon-hotfix. Coordinate with on-call SRE if enabling on older clusters.
notes_for_registry: No model artifacts changed. Runtime change only. Operators must update helm chart to include CRD when enabling the feature.
